scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run check:py
scripts.check:py: uv run ruff check src tests packaging && uv run ruff format --check src tests packaging && uv run ty check src && uv run ty check --python-platform win32 src && uv run pytest -q
scripts.test:ui: bun run build && DESK_TASKS_UI=1 bun test web/test/ui --timeout 60000
scripts.release: bun run build && uv build && uv run pytest tests/test_packaging.py -q
